name: vps-dog
description: A lightweight server monitoring tool that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers + D1, in the spirit of Komari and Nezha.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the initial `admin` account. Used only while the `users` table is empty — change it after your first login. If you leave this blank the bootstrap password is `admin`.
